title: Notice Share on Late Cancellations of Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Reservations
content:
**Training questions and answers — the cancellation notice share.**

**What is the rule?** For a late-cancelled Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation, the cancellation notice share depends on the calendar days from the cancellation date to the scheduled pickup date: two or more days of notice take **0.5** of the cancellation fee basis, one day of notice takes **0.75** of it, and a cancellation on the scheduled pickup date itself takes the whole cancellation fee basis.

**Are the days counted in hours?** No. They are calendar days between the two dates; the clock times of the cancellation and of the scheduled pickup play no part in this count.

**A reservation for Saturday is cancelled on Thursday. What share applies?** Thursday to Saturday is two calendar days, so the share is 0.5.

**The same reservation is cancelled on Friday at 23:50 for a Saturday 08:00 pickup. What share applies?** Friday to Saturday is one calendar day, so the share is 0.75, even though fewer than nine hours remain.

**It is cancelled on Saturday morning, before the pickup time. What share applies?** The cancellation is on the scheduled pickup date itself, so the whole cancellation fee basis applies (a share of 1).

| Calendar days from cancellation date to scheduled pickup date | Notice share of the cancellation fee basis |
|---|---|
| 0 | Whole (1) |
| 1 | 0.75 |
| 2 | 0.5 |
| 3 or more | 0.5 |
